description: Capabilities granted to the launcher's main window. Deliberately narrow: the window may manage itself, raise notifications, and open an external link through the user's browser. It may not read the filesystem, spawn processes, reach arbitrary hosts, or open native dialogs: those belong to the host, which uses them to ask for approval before any signature or endpoint change (the one exception, the QOR ID sign-in straight after unlocking, is approved by the passphrase: ADR-016), and a webview able to draw a look-alike would undermine them. The one process the webview can ask for is a test suite docs/GATES.toml defines, named only by its id, and the host runs it only after its own dialog is approved.
